'''Editan soup''' is a [[vegetable soup]] that originates from the [[Efik people|Efik People]] of [[Cross River State]] in South [[Nigeria]]. It is popularly known amongst the Cross River State people and Akwaibom State people. The soup is made from Editan leaf, a bitter leaf. Before being cooked the bitterness must be squeezed out.<ref>{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=nZIuAQAAIAAJ&q=Editan+soup|title=Culture, customs, and traditions of Cross River State people of Nigeria|last=Esema|first=Joseph D.|date=2002-01-01|publisher=MOCOMP|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=YF1YCg5Ig-EC&q=Editan+soup&pg=PA256|title=Multicultural Handbook of Food, Nutrition and Dietetics|last1=Thaker|first1=Aruna|last2=Barton|first2=Arlene|date=2012-04-23|publisher=John Wiley & Sons|isbn=9781405173582|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=QbQlAQAAIAAJ&q=Editan+soup|title=Briefs on Nigeria's indigenous and Western education: an interpretative history|last=Uyanga|first=Roseline E.|date=1998-01-01|publisher=Hall of Fame Educational Publishers|isbn=9789783073227|language=en}}</ref>

The editan leaf is believed to have medicinal values.{{citation needed|date=June 2026}}
